# Australian Culture

> An interactive guide to Australia in 19 stops: the land, 65,000 years of history, the people and the Aussie way, from famous faces and memes to wildlife and politics.

Australian Culture (Cultura Australiana in Portuguese) is a free, bilingual guide to Australia, part of BiblioVerse. English lives at the root and Brazilian Portuguese at /pt/. Every page cites its sources and links each item to Wikipedia. The pages build their lists with JavaScript, so the full text is also published as Markdown below.

## Full content

- [Full guide in English](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/llms-full.txt): every list on every stop, in Markdown
- [Guia completo em português](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/llms-full.txt): o mesmo conteúdo em português, com a comparação com o Brasil

## Stops

- [Famous Aussies](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/famous-aussies.html): The most famous Australians: actors, models, content creators and the Instagram rankings.
- [Music](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/music.html): Australian music from AC/DC, INXS and Midnight Oil to Kylie, Tame Impala and The Kid LAROI.
- [Film and TV](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/film-and-tv.html): Australian films, series and animation, plus the TV that is part of Aussie culture: soaps, reality, nostalgia and big broadcasts.
- [Companies and brands](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/brands.html): Australian companies and brands, from Qantas and BHP to Canva, Atlassian and the surf labels.
- [Food](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/food.html): Australian food: everyday eating and the icons, from Vegemite and Tim Tams to pies and pavlova.
- [Inventions](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/inventions.html): Australian inventions in chronological order: from the boomerang to Wi-Fi and Google Maps.
- [Virals and memes](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/virals-and-memes.html): Australian virals, memes and comedians: drop bears, the Great Emu War, democracy manifest, Bob Katter’s crocs, Hamish & Andy and more.
- [National passions](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/national-passions.html): What many Australians love, stereotypes included: the pub, the barbie, footy, the Melbourne Cup, utes, dry humour, blue heelers and kelpies.
- [Aussie Dictionary](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/aussie-dictionary.html): A dictionary of Aussie slang and everyday terms: arvo, brekkie, mate, servo, thongs and more than 130 words explained.
- [Records and rankings](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/records.html): Australian records and rankings: the longest fence, the longest golf course, the longest highway and more.
- [Fun facts](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/fun-facts.html): Fun facts about Australia: more kangaroos than people, Christmas in summer and other surprises.
- [Wildlife and plants](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/wildlife-and-plants.html): Native Australian wildlife and plants: kangaroos, koalas, lyrebirds, whales, gum trees, wattle and every state’s floral emblem.
- [Major cities](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/cities.html): The 25 biggest cities in Australia, on the map and in the rankings, plus a profile of each capital.
- [Places](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/places.html): Australia’s most popular and iconic places: beaches, national parks, natural wonders, buildings, bridges, monuments and the Big Things.
- [Moments in history](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/history.html): The history of Australia in 30 moments, from the First Peoples to the Brisbane 2032 Olympics.
- [Key dates](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/key-dates.html): Australia’s public holidays and key dates, from Australia Day to Anzac Day and NAIDOC Week, with First Nations views where a date is contested.
- [Politics and economy](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/politics-and-economy.html): Australian politics and economy: how the system works, parties, politicians, billionaires, activists, the minimum wage, cost of living and the biggest exports.
- [Find out more](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/websites.html): Key websites for getting to know Australia: Tourism Australia, the ABS, the Digital Atlas, AIATSIS, Trove, the ABC, SBS and more.
- [Are you true blue?](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/quiz.html): A quiz about Australia: test what you know about the country and its people.

## Em português

- [Cultura Australiana](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/): Guia interativo da Austrália em 19 paradas: a terra, 65 mil anos de história, o povo e o jeito australiano, de famosos e memes a natureza e política.
- [Famosos](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/famosos.html): Os australianos mais famosos: atores, modelos, criadores digitais e o ranking do Instagram.
- [Música](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/musica.html): Música australiana: de AC/DC, INXS e Midnight Oil a Kylie, Tame Impala e The Kid LAROI.
- [Filmes e séries](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/filmes-e-series.html): Filmes, séries e animações australianas, e a TV que faz parte da cultura: novelas, realities, nostalgia e grandes transmissões.
- [Empresas e marcas](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/marcas.html): Empresas e marcas australianas e as marcas gêmeas entre Brasil e Austrália.
- [Comida](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/comida.html): Comida australiana: o dia a dia e os ícones, de Vegemite e Tim Tam a meat pie e pavlova.
- [Invenções](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/invencoes.html): Invenções australianas em ordem cronológica: do bumerangue ao Wi-Fi e ao Google Maps.
- [Virais e memes](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/virais-e-memes.html): Virais, memes e comediantes australianos: drop bears, a Guerra dos Emus, democracy manifest, os crocodilos de Bob Katter, Hamish & Andy e mais.
- [Paixões nacionais](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/paixoes-nacionais.html): O que muitos australianos amam, estereótipos incluídos: o pub, o churrasco, o footy, a Melbourne Cup, os utes, o humor seco, os blue heelers e os kelpies.
- [Dicionário Aussie](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/dicionario.html): Dicionário de gírias e termos australianos: arvo, brekkie, mate, servo, thongs e mais de 130 palavras explicadas em português.
- [Recordes e índices](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/recordes.html): Recordes e índices da Austrália: a maior cerca, o maior campo de golfe, a maior rodovia e mais.
- [Curiosidades](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/curiosidades.html): Curiosidades sobre a Austrália: mais canguru que gente, Natal no verão e outras surpresas.
- [Fauna e flora](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/natureza.html): Fauna e flora nativas da Austrália: cangurus, coalas, pássaros-lira, baleias, eucaliptos, acácias e as flores símbolo de cada estado.
- [Principais cidades](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/cidades.html): As 25 cidades mais populosas da Austrália, no mapa e no ranking, e o perfil de cada capital.
- [Lugares](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/lugares.html): Os lugares mais populares e marcantes da Austrália: praias, parques nacionais, paisagens, edifícios, pontes, monumentos e as Big Things.
- [Fatos históricos](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/historia.html): A história da Austrália em 30 momentos, dos primeiros povos às Olimpíadas de Brisbane 2032.
- [Datas importantes](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/datas.html): Feriados e datas importantes da Austrália, do Australia Day ao Anzac Day e à Semana NAIDOC, com a crítica dos povos indígenas quando há.
- [Política e economia](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/politica-e-economia.html): Política e economia da Austrália: como funciona o sistema, partidos, políticos, bilionários, ativistas, salário mínimo, custo de vida e as maiores exportações.
- [Para conhecer mais](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/sites.html): Sites importantes para conhecer a Austrália: Tourism Australia, ABS, Digital Atlas, AIATSIS, Trove, ABC, SBS e outros.
- [Você é true blue?](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/quiz.html): Quiz sobre a Austrália: teste o que você sabe sobre o país e os australianos.

## Optional

- [About](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/about.html): About Australian Culture, a special BiblioVerse project created by Julio Cesar Prava, plus other projects to explore: Brazilians in Australia, Brazilian Culture and the Brisbane Vegan Guide.
- [Sobre](https://australianculture.biblioverse.org/pt/sobre.html): Sobre o projeto Cultura Australiana, projeto especial da BiblioVerse idealizado por Julio Cesar Prava, e outros projetos para conhecer: Brasileiros na Austrália, Cultura Brasileira e Brisbane Vegan Guide.
